root_cause: Commercial catalogue drift, missing checkout persistence, incomplete provisioning replay, pre-auth-only plan read and unacknowledged scan writes severed the same customer lineage.
prevention: Persist intent before provider side effect and reuse the same provider idempotency key.
Resume partial provisioning; do not return early just because a subscription exists.
Resolve paid account ownership only from confirmed provider identity and server-managed invitation truth.
Success URL and HTTP 200 are not storage/payment proof. Require exact server IDs and readback.
Keep existing personal workspace and tenant conflicts fail-closed; never silently reassign or erase.
Subscription provisioned is not verified revenue.
